title: Extension of SkillsFuture to Cover Degree Courses for Career Switchers
what_it_is: Extension of SkillsFuture to Cover Degree Courses for Career Switchers

sections.label: SkillsFuture Earn and Learn Programme extension
sections.summary: Asked whether the SkillsFuture Earn and Learn Programme can be extended to university education and workers seeking degrees to switch careers, addressing skills mismatch.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) whether the SkillsFuture Earn and Learn Programme can be extended to (i) university education and (ii) workers who wish to study for a first or second degree in order to switch careers and specialise in a different field, so as to address the growing skills mismatch in the labour market.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: There is less impetus to do this for universities because most graduates will not, at least not immediately, go beyond an undergraduate degree.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: Notwithstanding, there is much benefit to incorporate the concept of work-learn in undergraduate education and lifelong learning.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: Hence, the Singapore Institute of Technology already offers the integrated work-study programme, where undergraduates are attached to industries up to a year.

sections.label: Adapt and Grow lifelong learning programmes
sections.summary: Adult learners can tap on Adapt and Grow programmes such as Professional Conversion Programmes, which are work-learn in nature across industries including aerospace, logistics and social services.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: As for lifelong learning, adult learners can tap on various programmes under the Adapt and Grow initiative, such as the Professional Conversion Programmes (PCPs).

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: PCPs are available across a broad range of industries, including aerospace, logistics and social services, and are also work-learn in nature.
